metadata.name: Bengaluru running routes
metadata.warning: No feature contains a traced path. LineStrings are 2-point anchor estimates from Strava heatmap reading. Do NOT use for turn-by-turn navigation.

properties.name: Cubbon Park loop run
properties.timings: Open daily; group runs Sat 6:00 AM
properties.description: Flat ~4 km paved loop through central Bangalore's oldest park. Popular Saturday morning meetup for Cubbon Runs.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Jinke Park
properties.description: Large Chamrajpet park with shaded walking paths, two or three open-air gyms and a big children's play area with dinosaur statues. There is a lake inside, though a sewage smell drifts in at times. Split hours, shut through the middle of the day.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Gul Mohar Park
properties.description: Small, quiet park on the Air Force HQTC campus at Armane Nagar, used mainly by defence families. Shaded and calm, with little in the way of facilities. Thinly reviewed.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Defence Colony Park loop
properties.description: Small shaded park loop — short enough per round that laps stack easily. Quiet before 7 AM.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Indiranagar 100 Feet Road morning stretch
properties.description: Wide-footpath road run before traffic builds, with coffee stops at the far end.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Koramangala 6th Block inner-road loop
properties.description: Quiet residential grid that strings into a flat, well-lit loop before traffic starts. Easy to shorten or extend.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: 27th Main Road HSR morning stretch
properties.description: The neighbourhood spine — wide and straight enough to use as a tempo stretch. Quiet before 6:30 AM.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: AECS Layout D Block Football Ground
properties.timings: Opens around 4:00 PM; check gate notice
properties.description: Roughly 200-metre perimeter used for walking and jogging around the footballers and cricketers in the middle. Clean and safe for early-morning and late-evening loops, though gates are often shut outside posted hours.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Richmond Town Park
properties.description: Heavily shaded park with marked walking paths, outdoor gym equipment, over fifty benches and a kids play area. Dog friendly and well used for jogging and light exercise. Opens at 5 AM.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Indian Athletic Academy
properties.description: Structured athletics coaching on the stadium track — sprint and distance work, form, and mental preparation, individually tailored. 4.5 across 207 reviews. Coaches take athletes to competition.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Kittur Rani Chennamma Stadium (Running Track)
properties.description: BBMP stadium with a well-maintained public running track, open mornings and evenings on clean, spacious grounds. Popular with athletes and casual joggers alike. Washroom hygiene is the recurring complaint.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Attur BBMP Lake Park
properties.description: Lake park developed about two years ago, with a 2.2 km mud running and walking track, an open-air gym and peacocks about. Still being built out. Walkers advise against going alone in the very early morning.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Attur Lake Trail (proper)
properties.description: Natural walking track around Attur Lake, close to three kilometres, with an open-air gym, badminton courts and sunrise and sunset views. Recent sewage pollution has hit water quality and the lake ecosystem. Adjacent to the BBMP lake park.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Devarakere Park
properties.description: Small scenic lake with a jogging track, walking path, temple, children's play zone and open-air gym. Fresh air, and an easy morning or evening walk. Recent visitors mention rubbish building up in the lake, the smell that follows, and stray dogs around the track.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Sree Kanteerava Stadium (Running Track)
properties.description: Central Bangalore's biggest running track, used by athletes for sprints, long runs and drills. Also hosts Bengaluru FC football matches and other events. Closed Sundays.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Sri Chamarajendra Park (Cubbon Park)
properties.description: Bangalore's most iconic urban park: a vast tree canopy, running and walking loops, calm mornings and weekend flower shows. Central, and well kept by the horticulture department. The anchor point for running in central Bangalore, and one of the most reviewed places in the city. Closed Mondays.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Sankey Tank Park
properties.description: Historic Malleshwaram lake dating to 1882, circled by a scenic walking trail of about 1.5 km. Yoga areas, a public gym, children's play space, gazebos and benches. Cyclists are not permitted. Two open sessions daily, and a canonical Bangalore walking spot.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Jakkur Lake
properties.timings: Open daily; joggers' gate opens early morning
properties.description: About 3.5 km of shaded track around the lake; pelicans and wetland birds. Separate joggers' entry on the south-east side.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Yelahanka Kere
properties.description: About a 5 km loop with a mix of paved and mud track; one gate only, so plan the lap.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Mahadeva Banakara Park
properties.description: Park on 17th E Main with an inclined jogging track good for sprint work, plus a gymnastics area. No pets.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: SAI NCOE Athletics Track
properties.description: Sports Authority of India synthetic athletics track on the Bangalore University campus, with hockey, swimming and shooting alongside. Entry needs permission.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Sonu's Running Track
properties.description: Roughly 1 km mud track around Hoodi Lake — unpaved and uneven, but a genuine running loop with cool breezes and few distractions. Avoid after 6 PM, no lighting.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Inner Circle Ground Whitefield
properties.description: Large open ground on Inner Circle Road with a perimeter walking path, kids' park and space for several games at once. Open 24 hours.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Doddagubbi Lake
properties.description: Long dirt track running the full shoreline — roughly 4 km of maintained trail, quiet, with pelicans and open sky. One of the best distance loops in north Bengaluru. Not step-free; the track is unpaved.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Chokkanahalli Lake Park
properties.description: Small lake with a paved, well-fenced walking track set back from the main road. Clean and guarded, with a children's playground and a lot of waterbirds. Good short loop rather than a distance run.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Thirumenahalli Lake
properties.description: Roughly 1.25 km gravel walkway around the lake, with outdoor gym, gazebos and a children's play area. Strong birdlife — pelicans, herons, cormorants. Water levels drop in dry months.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Kanteerava Stadium Track
properties.description: Public running track at Kanteerava Stadium, 400 m synthetic when open. Best for speed work and intervals. A ticket is required and access is restricted during events, so check the public timings ahead.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Bannerghatta Butterfly Park Trail
properties.description: ~5-8km rolling trails around Bannerghatta Biological Park area (parts outside the paid zone). Cooler, forested, quieter. Weekend group runs occasionally organised. Watch for early-morning traffic on main road.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Turahalli Forest Trails
properties.description: Bangalore's last remaining urban forest, 600 acres of it. Trail running with some steep sections, and popular with mountain bikers and hikers too. Enter by 7 AM, as the sun heats the trail fast. No fee.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Puttenahalli Lake Loop
properties.description: ~1km walking/jogging path around restored Puttenahalli Lake. Small but scenic. Popular with JP Nagar community. Multiple loops for distance. Restoration led by PNLIT.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Bugle Rock Park loop
properties.description: Shaded walking paths winding between the granite outcrops off Bull Temple Road, with an open-air gym area. Roughly a 15-minute loop back to the Bull Temple Road gate. Litter around the rocks is the recurring complaint.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: M.N. Krishna Rao Park loop
properties.description: Big tree-covered park with a proper running track, three gates and a basketball court alongside. A full circuit takes 20 to 25 minutes at walking pace. Free entry and recently well maintained.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Basavanagudi Road Park circuit
properties.description: Small triangular park on Bull Temple Road with an open gym inside and a short walking circuit. Locals also use it for casual badminton. Restricted gate timings.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Malleshwara Public Park circuit
properties.description: Neighbourhood park off 16th Cross with clean walkways, a corner exercise station and plenty of benches. Planting is patchy but the paths are kept up.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Sadashivanagara Park loop
properties.description: Wide walking bay under bamboo groves just off Sankey Tank, with pull-up and parallel bars for calisthenics. Quiet at dawn and popular with early walkers.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Children's Park Sadashivanagara stroll
properties.description: Short lakeside stroll beside Sankey Tank with sunset views and a calm, low-traffic path. Free entry, parking outside. Lighting is thin after dark.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Madhavan Park circuit
properties.description: Large park off South End Road with old trees, two children's areas and an open gym, though the equipment is worn. Central, busy and easy to reach from Jayanagar or Hombegowda Nagar.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: B.N. Vijayakumar Park track
properties.description: Level walking track with tactile paving running the perimeter, stone pergolas every 200 m, plus yoga and outdoor gym space. Diagonally across from Jayanagar metro, open around the clock.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Wipro Park walk
properties.description: Long rectangular park on 80 Feet Road opposite Wipro, dense enough with trees to feel like a pocket forest. Paved paths and benches. Mosquitoes are bad in the evening and traffic noise carries.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Subrahmanya Swamy Park circuit
properties.description: Small 6th Block park with a walking track, basic outdoor gym and a kids' play area. Evening-only on most days — gates open from 4:30 PM.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: HSR Friends Park circuit
properties.description: Sector 3 park that works as a full outdoor fitness stop — walking paths, free gym equipment, yoga space, plus football, volleyball and badminton on the same ground.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Hemavathi Park loop
properties.description: Sector 1 park behind Assetz 27 Park Avenue with a well-designed walking path, gazebo, open-air theatre seating and an outdoor gym. Quiet and full of birdsong; the gym equipment rusts in the open.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Independence Park HSR loop
properties.description: Compact Sector 2 park with heavy shade that makes daytime running bearable, an amphitheatre that hosts events and an open gym. Carry repellent for evenings.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: Sector 4 Park HSR circuit
properties.description: Green Sector 4 park with a walking track and kids' area, and one of the few nearby that stays open through the afternoon. Roadside parking is easy.
properties.geometry_precision: start/centre point only; no path geometry

properties.name: CMH Road stretch
properties.description: East along CMH Road from the 12th Main junction toward Old Madras Rd. Heavy heat on the heatmap; wide footpath but busy traffic. Best before 7 AM.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: 80 Feet Road — 12th Main to Domlur
properties.description: South along 80 Feet Road from 12th Main to the Domlur flyover. One of the darkest corridors in the Indiranagar heatmap. Signal-interrupted.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: 12th Main to Double Road
properties.description: Short connector from 12th Main west to Double Road Park. Feeds the Defence Colony grid loops.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Defence Colony grid loop
properties.description: Rectangular loop through the Defence Colony inner roads north of CMH Road. Low traffic, tree cover, popular for repeats.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Thippasandra Main Road
properties.description: East along Thippasandra Main Rd through HAL 3rd Stage. Connects Kuvempu Park and GP Raja Ratnam Park; commercial stretch, busier after 8 AM.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Wheeler Road Extension — north to south
properties.description: Straight north-south run down Wheeler Road Extension through Cooke Town. The main street route in an area with almost no park options.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Jayamahal Main — northbound
properties.description: Northbound along Jayamahal Main Road past the palace grounds. Wide shoulder, long uninterrupted stretch.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Bellandur Lake Road — south to north
properties.description: North along Bellandur Lake Road from the ORR side. Dark heat on the Strava layer despite the lake itself being unusable — runners use the road, not the water's edge.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Kadubeesanahalli Road — APH to IPRR junction
properties.description: Uphill stretch from Ambalipura Halli Road to the Inner Peripheral Ring Road junction. Short, steep, used for repeats.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Doddanekkundi Industrial Area loop
properties.description: Grid loop through the industrial layout roads north of Doddanekkundi Lake. Very low traffic before 7 AM; the densest heat cluster in the Mahadevapura tile.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Whitefield Road — Hoodi to Mahadevapura
properties.description: Long west-bound stretch of Whitefield Road. Continuous footpath most of the way; heavy traffic after 7:30 AM.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Pattandur Agrahara Metro to Kadugodi Tree Park Metro
properties.description: Metro-to-metro run along the Whitefield main road. Useful point-to-point — start at one station, finish at the other.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: ITI loop — KR Puram
properties.description: Loop around the ITI grounds and adjacent roads. Grass ground in the middle, road perimeter; waterlogs after heavy rain.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Sankey Touch & Back
properties.description: Out-and-back along Sankey Road from the tank to the Palace Ground side. Dark heat; the classic Malleshwaram street run.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Palace Ground Parallel
properties.description: Runs the road parallel to the Palace Grounds boundary. Long uninterrupted stretch, wide shoulder, one of the few road options in a tight area.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Jayamahal Main — northbound
properties.description: Northbound past the palace grounds. Duplicate anchor to RT-060 but filed to Vasanth Nagar, which has almost no road options.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: New BEL Road
properties.description: Wide arterial with continuous footpath. Heavily used early; commercial and busy after 8 AM.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Nandi Durga Road climb
properties.description: Short sustained climb toward Nandi Durga Road. Used for hill repeats — the only gradient in the tile.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: Vidyapeetha to Ring Road
properties.description: East from Vidyapeetha Circle toward the Outer Ring Road. Wide, straight, moderate heat.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path

properties.name: BDA hill repeats — Banashankari
properties.description: Short steep repeat stretch on the BDA layout roads. The main gradient option in south-west Bengaluru.
properties.geometry_precision: anchor-estimate (~1 block); NOT a traced path
